title: Velvety Sweet Algerian Date Tagine
description: A rich and sweet Algerian dish featuring roasted dates and a hint of chocolate, perfect for special occasions. This recipe is ayurvedic rajasic friendly and uses palm sugar and nam tan pip for added flavor.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Rinse the dates and remove the pits, then place them in a baking dish.
In a saucepan, combine the palm sugar, nam tan pip, and water, and bring to a boil over medium heat.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer the sugar mixture for 10 minutes, or until it reaches 300 degrees Fahrenheit on a candy thermometer.
Remove the sugar mixture from the heat and stir in the chopped chocolate until it is melted and smooth.
Pour the chocolate mixture over the dates and toss to coat.
Cover the baking dish with aluminum foil and bake for 20 minutes.
Remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 10 minutes, or until the dates are caramelized and the sauce is bubbly.
Remove the tagine from the oven and stir in the coconut oil, vanilla extract, cinnamon, and ginger.
Let the tagine cool to room temperature before serving.
